contracts.name: ZZZAccessController
contracts.purpose: Immediate scheduled governance, fixed module identity, independent pause/keeper roles and whole-collection lifecycle authorization.

functions.name: constructor
functions.purpose: Deploy the zero-delay controller and initialize proposer/executor/keeper/guardian roles. Deployer becomes temporary bootstrap.
functions.access: Deployment only; creates the immutable RoyaltyFactory. Sealing later permanently clears bootstrap.

inputs.name: delay
inputs.label: delay
inputs.explanation: Must be 0; no future delay change is supported.

inputs.name: proposers
inputs.label: proposers
inputs.explanation: Nonempty nonzero proposer addresses; initial proposers also receive cancellation role.

inputs.name: executors
inputs.label: executors
inputs.explanation: Nonempty executor list; zero address opens execution of exact scheduled operations, not proposal authority.

inputs.name: initialKeeper
inputs.label: initialKeeper
inputs.explanation: Nonzero bounded-maintenance operator.

inputs.name: initialGuardian
inputs.label: initialGuardian
inputs.explanation: Nonzero pause-only emergency role.

functions.name: CANCELLER_ROLE

functions.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE

functions.name: EXECUTOR_ROLE

functions.name: PROPOSER_ROLE

functions.name: activationAssetsFactory
functions.purpose: Return the immutable noncustodial ActivationAssets factory created by this controller.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Fixed factory address. Its access() must equal this controller, and assetsOf(Registry) must equal the Registry's bound ActivationAssets child.

functions.name: bind
functions.purpose: Bind one previously empty module slot during deployment. One-time slot binding; rejected for retired bridge/receiver/routes/transport IDs. The implementation must have code and the same controller.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: Exact Ids module identity hash to bind; retired bridge/receiver/routes/transport identities are rejected.

inputs.name: implementation
inputs.label: implementation
inputs.explanation: Deployed compatible module with code, access() bound to this controller, and an unused module slot.

functions.name: bootstrap
functions.purpose: Read the temporary deployment/bootstrap authority; zero after seal.

functions.name: canConfigure
functions.purpose: Check whether an address may currently call governed configuration.

inputs.name: account
inputs.label: account
inputs.explanation: account is the immediate caller being checked.

outputs.label: output0

functions.name: cancel
functions.purpose: Cancel a pending scheduled governance operation.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: id is the exact operation commitment; completed/unset operations cannot be cancelled.

functions.name: cancelPreparation
functions.purpose: Cancel the exact active preparation notice while the source is still operating. Does not rewind a frozen/retired handoff or move custody. Exact noticeHash prevents cancelling a later announcement.

inputs.name: noticeHash
inputs.label: noticeHash
inputs.explanation: noticeHash must equal preparationHash().

functions.name: canonicalHandoff
functions.purpose: Read the fixed whole-collection handoff coordinator.

functions.name: canonicalSettling
functions.purpose: Read whether the coordinator has enabled its bounded settlement phase.

functions.name: canonicalState
functions.purpose: Read canonical lifecycle: 0 operating, 1 frozen, 2 importing, 3 retired, 4 cancelled.

functions.name: canonicalTransition
functions.purpose: Allow only the bound coordinator to change canonical lifecycle; terminal retired/cancelled states and impossible higher states cannot reopen.
functions.access: Bound canonicalHandoff only; internal protocol endpoint, not an operator shortcut.

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: state
inputs.explanation: Canonical lifecycle code 0 operating / 1 frozen / 2 importing / 3 retired / 4 cancelled.

inputs.name: settling
inputs.label: settling
inputs.explanation: True permits the coordinator’s bounded settlement phase only when state=1; false disables settlement mode.

inputs.name: clearPreparation
inputs.label: clearPreparation
inputs.explanation: True clears preparationActive during this authenticated transition; false preserves the current flag.

functions.name: execute
functions.purpose: Execute the exact previously scheduled operation or atomic batch. Cannot alter approved target/value/calldata/salt. Failed target/predecessor checks revert; generic execution does not make the controller the Vault or bypass target permissions.
functions.access: EXECUTOR_ROLE, or anyone if the zero address has the open executor role.

inputs.name: target
inputs.label: target
inputs.explanation: Exact destination contract/account whose address is committed in the scheduled operation.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: value
inputs.explanation: Native ETH amount in wei delivered to target; distinct from caller msg.value and network gas.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.label: payload
inputs.explanation: Exact target function selector plus ABI-encoded arguments, byte-identical to the scheduled payload.

inputs.name: predecessor
inputs.label: predecessor
inputs.explanation: Exact prerequisite operation ID, or bytes32 zero for no prerequisite; a nonzero predecessor must be completed before execution.

inputs.name: salt
inputs.label: salt
inputs.explanation: Caller-chosen bytes32 operation discriminator, included in the operation hash and required unchanged at execution.

functions.purpose: Irreversibly close bootstrap after complete unique module/companion, randomness and matching nonzero fixed contribution/exit ZZZ bindings are validated.

functions.name: setGuardian
functions.purpose: Enable or disable a guardian address. Guardians may pause immediately; they cannot unpause solely by holding this role.
